purpose: Minimal executable WELP-side import/compatibility layer over EXISTING LLMGauge producer evidence formats, plus deterministic repetition summarization. WELP stays the read-only consumer: no LLMGauge edits, no competing export format, no metric inference. The practical-suite role is retained — native run/suite evidence imports under the same identity discipline as the LocalMaxxing speed module; this contract is not speed-only.
protocol_basis: welp/protocol/WELP.md — methodology revision 2026-09-23: 'An import must cite immutable raw artifact/hash, exact profile/runtime/hardware/workload, metric boundary/unit, cache state, requested/effective settings and availability. Missing or incommensurate metrics are not inferred.'
llmgauge/docs/LOCALMAXXING_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md and llmgauge/src/llmgauge/core/localmaxxing.py — producer artifact shape and fingerprint algorithm (read as format authority; never modified).
llmgauge/docs/ARTIFACT_SCHEMAS.md — llmgauge.result.v0 identity and referenced-artifact semantics.

supported.shape: benchmark.json as file or artifact directory; companion raw files (execution-evidence.json REQUIRED as the repetition raw pin, ttft-evidence.json REQUIRED whenever ttft is carried, telemetry-evidence.json and localmaxxing-submission-receipt.json optional) are digested and cross-checked against the sealed artifact
supported.verification: producer fingerprint recomputed over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii) with the fingerprint member omitted; aggregate = arithmetic mean checks; repetition count/workload.warmup_repetitions consistency; positive finite observations; telemetry aggregate-vs-samples checks; REQUIRED positional repetition raw pin against execution-evidence.json (see import.fail_closed_rules.repetition_raw_pin) and ttft-evidence.json pin whenever ttft is carried
supported.metrics: tok_s_out, tok_s_prefill (tok/s, decode/prefill boundaries respectively), tok_s_total (companion combined run), ttft mean/samples (ms, benchmark proxy), telemetry peaks (MiB/W/C/%)

supported.scope: bounded single-run import: run status, model/runtime/suite identity, sampler and cache fields with their *_state semantics, per-task metric availability, referenced raw artifact hashes (raw prompt/output/stderr/cleaned paths), transcript digest verification. result.v0 carries NO hardware, cache-regime or timing-boundary facts: those required axes are satisfiable only through a verified digest-pinned sidecar; absent, the import is NON_COMPARABLE — a result.v0 import without them is descriptive evidence, never a qualified comparison.
supported.explicitly_not: no cross-task pooling (different prompts are different workloads); no repetition/warmup structure exists in this format; run_fingerprint is recorded, not recomputed (producer payload versions v0-v7 vary); agent-harness/external-benchmark dedicated import shapes carry no native measurements and are refused

import.interface: harness/measurement.py: import_llmgauge(source: Path, expected: dict) -> {status, reasons, metrics, provenance}
import.required_identity: expected must carry the COMPLETE preregistered comparison identity (REQUIRED_EXPECTED_AXES in harness/measurement.py) for the routed producer format — source-bytes pin, model-artifact identity pin, cache_regime, timing_boundary, metric boundary/units, model identity, engine/runtime build, hardware, effective offload/KV, workload geometry incl. context_length, repetitions and warmup policy. A missing caller axis is NON_COMPARABLE ('expected comparison identity incomplete'), never an implicit don't-care; structural unavailability in the native format never relaxes the gate — the axis is then satisfied ONLY through a verified digest-pinned sidecar, and absent evidence means NON_COMPARABLE. Unknown expected keys (typos, unsupported axes) are rejected, never ignored.

fail_closed_rules.read_only: the source is never written, moved, or repaired
fail_closed_rules.missing_metadata: unavailability is judged from the SOURCE ONLY. A caller-supplied expected value never substitutes for absent source metadata; each such axis yields an explicit availability reason and NON_COMPARABLE.
fail_closed_rules.null_semantics: an explicit producer null means the field is not represented and is treated as absent (sidecar-fillable)
fail_closed_rules.model_artifact_identity: the producer fingerprint/seal authenticates the BENCHMARK BYTES, not the model artifact. The model file digest (model_artifact_sha256) must be verified independently: via model.provenance.sha256 for result.v0, or via a digest-pinned qualification sidecar reference (e.g. a model manifest) for the localmaxxing format. Name/revision/quantization/size never stand in for artifact identity.
fail_closed_rules.repetition_raw_pin: the sealed repetitions must verify positionally against the raw llama-bench evidence: repetition i is exactly one prefill row (n_prompt=workload.prompt_tokens, n_gen=0) and one decode row (n_prompt=0, n_gen=workload.output_tokens) whose avg_ts equal the sealed tok_s_prefill/tok_s_out pair, with per-row engine config (n_batch, n_ubatch, type_k/type_v, n_gpu_layers, no_kv_offload, split_mode, main_gpu, load_mode) matching the artifact runtime. Set membership of throughputs proves nothing (swaps/duplicates pass it) and is not accepted. execution-evidence.json is required; ttft-evidence.json is required whenever the artifact carries ttft.
fail_closed_rules.hashes: producer fingerprint (localmaxxing), source file digest, every companion/raw referenced file digest, and transcript digest are verified; any mismatch is NON_COMPARABLE
fail_closed_rules.unavailable: explicit noncomparability, never inference; reasons carry machine-stable prefixes (schema:/hash:/availability:/axis:/unit:/raw:/sidecar:/consistency:)

expected_axes.sections: model/engine/hardware/runtime/workload objects hold dotted axis keys matched against actual producer fields (native names preferred; e.g. runtime.kv_cache_type_k, hardware.gpu_name, workload.warmup_repetitions)
top_level: cache_regime (REQUIRED) — no native producer field; satisfied only through the verified digest-pinned sidecar, else NON_COMPARABLE

timing_boundary (REQUIRED) — no native producer field (which window the metric measures: decode-only, prefill, end-to-end, first-token); satisfied only through the verified digest-pinned sidecar, else NON_COMPARABLE
metric_units (REQUIRED, non-empty) — expectations checked against the native metric definitions; contradiction or unknown metric is a unit-definition mismatch
workload.context_length (REQUIRED, in the workload section) — optional native localmaxxing field, matched when present, sidecar-filled otherwise; result.v0 pins it natively via runtime.ctx_size
artifact_fingerprint — optional additional producer-fingerprint pin (localmaxxing only)
repetition_structure — available for localmaxxing, explicitly unavailable for single-run result.v0

qualification_sidecar.rule: An evidenced sidecar may fill an ABSENT source field ONLY when immutable references allow verifying the actual value; assertions are never accepted. It never overrides a present source value.
qualification_sidecar.fields_entry: {axis: {value, evidence: {path, sha256, json_pointer}}} — the referenced evidence file must exist inside the source tree, hash exactly to the pinned sha256, and its JSON pointer must resolve to exactly the claimed value
qualification_sidecar.sidecar_pinning: REQUIRED: expected.qualification_sidecar.expected_sha256 must pin the sidecar file itself; an unpinned sidecar is not an immutable reference and is rejected
qualification_sidecar.failure: any unverifiable entry is an explicit sidecar: reason and the axis stays unavailable

availability_vocabulary.available: the admitted source directly carries the value or exact bytes
availability_vocabulary.absent: the supported format permits omission and no value is present (cache_regime, cold-start lane, context window)
availability_vocabulary.unavailable: required evidence is missing, invalid, or contradicted; always NON_COMPARABLE when the axis was demanded
availability_vocabulary.note: aligned with the LLMGauge closed availability vocabulary; an availability state is not a value

channels_and_roles.ttft: imported benchmark TTFT is labeled proxy_benchmark_ttft and is never direct deployment TTFT
channels_and_roles.channels: stream-first-token, final-first-output and end-to-end observations are kept separate end to end and never pooled
channels_and_roles.warmup: warmup exclusion is the producer-method preregistered designated sample only (workload.warmup_repetitions, evidenced by raw warmup stdout); never retrospective
channels_and_roles.evidence_availability: every import reports an explicit evidence_availability block: measurements, warmup evidence, cold-start, background-load telemetry, TTFT, hardware, KV-cache config, cache regime, actual prompt tokens, referenced raw artifacts

summarization.reported: all raw values in execution order (including designated warmups), n, mean, sample_sd (n-1; null at n<2), median, min, max, cv
summarization.default_policy: prospective warmed: 1 designated warmup + 5 measured repetitions; a separately measured cold process-startup lane is summarized independently and never pooled
summarization.warmup_rule: warmups are excluded only as preregistered designated samples, batch-major (batch_warmups [1,1] removes the first observation of EACH batch, never two consecutive observations of one batch); no retrospective outlier removal (outlier_removal is always 'none')
summarization.variance_flag: CV > 0.10 fires only as a preregistered policy trigger (cv_flag_threshold; explicit null disables). The first batch's CV and trigger are reported separately (first_batch); the pooled flag governs the reported set.
summarization.additional_batch: when preregistered (max_batches 2), the ONE additional batch is legitimate ONLY on a first-batch variance trigger; a trigger with only the first batch present yields lane status 'pending_additional_batch' (incomplete, extension required before any gate decision); after the second batch ALL observations are retained and reported pooled with a residual_flag; executed-but-untriggered or unpreregistered batches are rejected
summarization.pooling: different workloads and different policies are never pooled; one call summarizes exactly one workload under one policy; result.v0 per-task metrics are never pooled across prompts
summarization.confidence_interval: none; IID confidence intervals are unsupported and never emitted
summarization.determinism: pure functions of inputs; identical inputs yield byte-identical JSON output

harness.selftest: python3 harness/measurement.py selftest — native-compatible synthetic import in the exact producer shape (internally consistent positional pp/tg raw rows, digest-pinned sidecar covering model-artifact identity, cache_regime and timing_boundary, native optional workload.context_length, complete frozen expectation) plus rejection for: incomplete caller identity, unknown/typo'd expected keys, each critical identity/cache/context/unit/metric/repetition/provenance mismatch, swapped repetitions (positional pin), missing observations, nonfinite values, missing raw pins, unpinned/unverifiable sidecar; deterministic summary tests incl. batch-major batch_warmups exclusion, trigger-gated extension (untriggered second batch rejected, pending_additional_batch status, residual flag), and policy type discipline. No real LFM evidence is imported or fabricated in the selftest.
cli: python3 harness/measurement.py import SOURCE EXPECTED_JSON (exit 0 COMPATIBLE, 1 NON_COMPARABLE, 2 usage/IO)
harness.dependencies: Python standard library only; no network, no model execution, no GPU access

unmet_schema_requirements.model_artifact_digest: llmgauge.localmaxxing_benchmark.v1 carries model identity only as hf_id/revision/local_reference/quantization/profile plus model_size in raw rows — never the model file digest. The source fingerprint authenticates benchmark bytes, not the model artifact; a COMPATIBLE import therefore requires a digest-pinned qualification sidecar referencing an immutable model manifest, and real artifacts without one are NON_COMPARABLE by design.
unmet_schema_requirements.cache_regime: no native cache-reuse-regime field in either format; the axis is REQUIRED and satisfied only through the verified digest-pinned sidecar, else NON_COMPARABLE — cache policy is never inferred from artifact bytes. KV/offload/placement configuration axes ARE native and required.
unmet_schema_requirements.timing_boundary: no explicit timing-boundary field in either format; the axis is REQUIRED (which window each metric measures) and satisfied only through the verified digest-pinned sidecar, else NON_COMPARABLE
unmet_schema_requirements.context_window: workload.context_length is REQUIRED. localmaxxing carries it only as an optional producer field (mapped when present; per audit it can exist additively), sidecar-filled otherwise — prompt depth is never a context-window substitute. result.v0 pins it natively via runtime.ctx_size (configured capacity, not validated occupancy).
unmet_schema_requirements.requested_vs_effective: localmaxxing runtime fields are command-requested values; effective placement/KV residency is evidence only via raw llama-bench rows (n_gpu_layers, type_k/type_v, no_kv_offload), which the positional raw pin verifies per repetition
unmet_schema_requirements.run_fingerprint_recomputation: llmgauge.result.v0 run_fingerprint payloads (producer versions v0-v7) are recorded, not recomputed; verification relies on file and referenced-artifact digests
unmet_schema_requirements.cold_start_lane: no producer format measures cold process startup; a cold lane must come from WELP's own measurement
unmet_schema_requirements.telemetry_scope: localmaxxing telemetry is total-device (nvidia-smi), not per-model attribution

non_goals: no LLMGauge repository changes; LLMGauge remains an optional, overlapping evidence producer
no network, submission, publication, or external actions
no metric renaming, flattening, inference, or relabeling of historical campaigns
no replacement of WELP context scaling, deployment lanes, or classification contracts
historical_compatibility: Applies prospectively from 2026-09-24. Existing campaign evidence is never re-imported or relabeled by this contract; producer artifacts already recorded in campaigns (e.g. the LFM2.5-8B-A1B retest-2 localmaxxing-artifact) keep their original interpretation, and this module's read-only import adds nothing to them.
